title: US Stock Market Live Updates: S&P 500, Nasdaq advance as oil eases ahead of Fed decision - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones | Nasdaq | Stock Market Live: US stocks trade mixed on Tuesday as easing oil prices support risk appetite ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq gain, while the Dow slips. Investors also track key earnings, with Tesla and chip stocks advancing and Boeing falling after a wider loss.

- Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management

- Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management
